source_semantics: A provider/persisted period or status contradiction appends an unknown canonical observation. A failed read with a still-eligible prior typed observation appends a supersession marker by copying only prior typed quantities/reference and setting canonical status unknown. It is not a new invoice, balance, payment, delivery or provider verification. Without a prior eligible observation, failure503 creates no invented source.

metrics: Select latest observation per invoice/payment before eligibility filtering, so later unknown/canceled/refunded evidence cannot leave an older paid event counted. Count only distinct verified paid active period advances; no email causality.
